import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def solve(inp):
    h=len(inp); w=len(inp[0]); out=[r[:] for r in inp]
    seen=[[False]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if seen[i][j]: continue
            c=inp[i][j]; st=[(i,j)]; seen[i][j]=True; comp=[]
            while st:
                x,y=st.pop(); comp.append((x,y))
                for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    nx,ny=x+dx,y+dy
                    if 0<=nx<h and 0<=ny<w and not seen[nx][ny] and inp[nx][ny]==c:
                        seen[nx][ny]=True; st.append((nx,ny))
            rs=[p[0] for p in comp]; cs=[p[1] for p in comp]
            r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
            if len(comp)!=(r1-r0+1)*(c1-c0+1): continue
            if r0==0 or r1==h-1 or c0==0 or c1==w-1: continue
            border=[inp[x][y] for x in range(r0,r1+1) for y in range(c0,c1+1) if (x in (r0,r1) or y in (c0,c1))]
            if any(v!=c for v in border): continue
            ints={inp[x][y] for x in range(r0+1,r1) for y in range(c0+1,c1)}
            n=(r1-r0-1)*(c1-c0-1)
            if n==0: continue
            fill=7 if n%2 else 2
            for x in range(r0+1,r1):
                for y in range(c0+1,c1):
                    out[x][y]=fill
    return out
